purpose: Bounded synthetic native Claude probe for multipart SubagentStart additionalContext

setup.hookScript: An unchanged copy of the production claude_event.py hook was used in an isolated scratch directory.
setup.settings: Equivalent settings were generated manually for this probe, not materialized by the Swift launch planner. SessionStart and SubagentStop used the production event hook; SubagentStart used that hook plus five numbered child-context commands matching the planner's command shape.
setup.context: Synthetic UTF-8 only, frozen to a protected local file with SHA-256 checked by each hook command; no user skill or credentials were read.
setup.cliMode: Single noninteractive -p JSON call, no session persistence, empty setting sources, strict MCP configuration, Agent as the only parent tool, no child tools, permission mode dontAsk.

observed.hookSignatures: Hook-generated HMAC fields were present; cryptographic verification was not independently performed in this probe because the ephemeral key was not retained.

limits: This establishes delivery through Claude Code's native child hook path in one print-mode invocation. It does not exercise the Swift planner's file materialization, interactive TUI behavior, or app-level child-box routing.
cleanup: The owned CLI process exited normally; the 90-second process-group watchdog did not fire. No extra model call was made.
